nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, Borsuk's conjecture in dimension $n$ is the statement that the Borsuk number of the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ is at most $n + 1$.
nodes.title: Borsuk's conjecture in a given dimension

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the Borsuk number of the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ is at most $k$ if and only if every bounded subset $s$ of $\mathbb{R}^n$ with at least two points has a $k$-piece Borsuk cover, that is, $s$ is covered by $k$ sets, each of extended diameter strictly smaller than that of $s$.
nodes.title: Upper bounds on the Borsuk number of a Euclidean space

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the Borsuk number of the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ is the supremum, in $\mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}$, of the Borsuk numbers of the bounded subsets of $\mathbb{R}^n$ with at least two points.
nodes.title: Borsuk number of a Euclidean space

nodes.summary: The first Borsuk failure dimension is $\infty$ if and only if, for every positive integer $n$, the Borsuk number of the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ is at most $n + 1$.
nodes.title: When the first Borsuk failure dimension is infinite

nodes.summary: The first Borsuk failure dimension is the least positive integer $n$ such that the Borsuk number of the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ is greater than $n + 1$, and $\infty$ if there is no such $n$.
nodes.title: First Borsuk failure dimension

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, a set $s$ in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ has a $k$-piece Borsuk cover if and only if there are $k$ closed subsets of $\mathbb{R}^n$ whose union contains $s$, each of extended diameter strictly smaller than that of $s$.
nodes.title: Borsuk covers by closed sets

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, a set $s$ in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ has a $k$-piece Borsuk cover if and only if there are subsets $c_1, \dots, c_k$ of $s$ with $s = c_1 \cup \dots \cup c_k$, each of extended diameter strictly smaller than that of $s$.
nodes.title: Borsuk covers by subsets

nodes.summary: Let $n$, $k$ and $l$ be natural numbers with $k \le l$. If a nonempty set $s$ in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ has a $k$-piece Borsuk cover, then $s$ has an $l$-piece Borsuk cover.
nodes.title: Enlarging a Borsuk cover

nodes.summary: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers. If a nonempty set $s$ in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ has a $k$-piece Borsuk cover, then $0 < k$.
nodes.title: Borsuk covers of nonempty sets have at least one piece

nodes.summary: Let $s$ be a set in an extended pseudometric space and let $k$ be a natural number. The set $s$ has a $k$-piece Borsuk cover if there are $k$ sets whose union contains $s$, each of extended diameter strictly smaller than that of $s$.
nodes.title: Borsuk covers

nodes.summary: A set $s$ in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ is a two-distance set if there are reals $0 < a < b$ such that the distance between any two distinct points of $s$ is $a$ or $b$, and both $a$ and $b$ occur as the distance between some two points of $s$.
nodes.title: Two-distance sets

nodes.summary: For a nonempty set $s$ in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ and a natural number $k$, the Borsuk number of $s$ is at most $k$ if and only if $s$ has a $k$-piece Borsuk cover.
nodes.title: Bounds on the Borsuk number of a set

nodes.summary: If a set $s$ in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ has a $k$-piece Borsuk cover for a natural number $k$, then the Borsuk number of $s$ is at most $k$.
nodes.title: A Borsuk cover bounds the Borsuk number

nodes.summary: The Borsuk number of a set $s$ in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ is the least natural number $k$ such that $s$ has a $k$-piece Borsuk cover, that is, $s$ is covered by $k$ sets each of strictly smaller extended diameter than $s$; it is $\infty$ if no such $k$ exists.
nodes.title: Borsuk number of a set

nodes.summary: The two-distance Borsuk number in dimension $n$ is the supremum, taken in $\mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}$, of the Borsuk numbers of all bounded two-distance sets with at least two points in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$.
nodes.title: Two-distance Borsuk number in dimension $n$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
